video.title: Where Would You Rank in History
video.script: For almost all of recorded history, one fact decided your entire life: who your parents were. Today we can reverse it. Tell this tool who you are, pick any civilization and any age, and it calculates exactly where you'd rank in that hierarchy. Birth, merit, wealth, faith. See which traits pushed people up. Try it with yourself, link in the description.
